issues.issue: The form prints this under Business-Type Activities, but it was paid from governmental fund columns. Treating it as governmental is defensible and already marked review. Street Fund paying 3,298.10 of solid waste is unusual.
The ending_fund_balance key is missing from the JSON. It should be present as null for a cash-basis report.
